name: toast
title: Toast
description: Self-contained notification stack with a provider, useToast composable and three variants.
docs: Wrap the app in ToastProvider, then call useToast().toast({ title, description, variant, action, duration }). The provider keeps at most max notifications (3 by default) and drops the oldest first; duration defaults to 4000ms, pauses on hover or focus, and zero keeps one open. variant danger uses the theme danger colour and role alert. The stack teleports to body at z-60 so it stays above dialogs.

files.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { onBeforeUnmount, provide } from 'vue'
import { toastKey, type ToastApi, type ToastOptions } from './context'
import { createToastStack, provideToastStack } from './stack'
import Toaster from './Toaster.vue'

export type ToastProviderProps = {
  /** Milliseconds a notification stays open, overridable per call. */
  duration?: number
  /** Oldest notifications beyond this count are dropped immediately. */
  max?: number
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<ToastProviderProps>(), {
  duration: 4000,
  max: 3,
})

const stack = createToastStack()
provideToastStack(stack)
onBeforeUnmount(stack.dismissAll)

function toast(options: ToastOptions): string {
  return stack.push(options, props.duration, props.max)
}

const api: ToastApi = {
  toast,
  dismiss: stack.dismiss,
  dismissAll: stack.dismissAll,
}
provide(toastKey, api)

defineExpose({ toast, dismiss: stack.dismiss, dismissAll: stack.dismissAll })
</script>

<template>
  <slot />
  <Toaster />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ToastRegion } from '@ui-sdk/vue/toast'
import Toast from './Toast.vue'
import type { ToastRecord } from './context'
import { useToastStack } from './stack'
import { toastViewport } from './styles'

const { toaster, items } = useToastStack()
</script>

<template>
  <ToastRegion
    :toaster="toaster"
    :max-visible="Math.max(1, items.length)"
    expanded
    aria-label="Notifications"
    :class="toastViewport"
  >
    <template #default="{ toast }">
      <Toast :record="toast.data as ToastRecord" />
    </template>
  </ToastRegion>
</template>

import type { ToastVariant } from './context'

export const toastViewport = [
  'pointer-events-none fixed bottom-4 right-4 z-[60] m-0 w-[min(22rem,calc(100vw-2rem))] [&>[data-slot=toast-list]]:flex [&>[data-slot=toast-list]]:flex-col [&>[data-slot=toast-list]]:gap-2',
].join(' ')

export const toastCard = [
  'pointer-events-auto flex items-start gap-3 rounded-panel border border-line bg-raised p-4 shadow-popup',
].join(' ')

const variantAccent: Record<ToastVariant, string> = {
  default: 'bg-line',
  success: 'bg-accent',
  danger: 'bg-danger',
}

/** Left edge marker that tints the card without recolouring the text. */
export function toastAccent(variant: ToastVariant): string {
  return `absolute inset-y-3 left-0 w-0.5 rounded-full ${variantAccent[variant]}`
}

export const toastTitle = 'text-[14px] font-medium text-ink'

export const toastDescription = 'mt-0.5 text-[13px] text-ink-muted'

export const toastActions = 'mt-2 flex items-center gap-2'

export const toastAction = [
  'h-auto rounded-[8px] border-0 bg-transparent px-2 py-1 text-[12px] font-medium text-ink',
  'hover:bg-control active:scale-95 motion-reduce:active:scale-100',
  'transition-[background-color,color,transform] duration-[var(--p0seid0n-duration-fast)] ease-spring motion-reduce:transition-none',
  'outline-none focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-solid focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-ink',
].join(' ')

export const toastDismiss = [
  'ml-auto inline-flex size-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-[6px] border-0 bg-transparent p-0 before:hidden after:hidden',
  'text-[14px] leading-none text-ink-muted',
  'hover:bg-control hover:text-ink active:scale-95 motion-reduce:active:scale-100',
  'transition-[background-color,color,transform] duration-[var(--p0seid0n-duration-fast)] ease-spring motion-reduce:transition-none',
  'outline-none focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-solid focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-ink',
].join(' ')

export { default as ToastProvider } from './ToastProvider.vue'
export { default as Toaster } from './Toaster.vue'

export { useToast } from './context'
export type { ToastAction, ToastApi, ToastOptions, ToastRecord, ToastVariant } from './context'
export type { ToastProviderProps } from './ToastProvider.vue'
